question: Which country's President made an underwater speech to call for stronger action to protect oceans in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4) Seychelles**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Seychelles** President made an underwater speech in 2019 to draw attention to the urgent need for stronger ocean protection.
 
• This unique act was part of a campaign to highlight the negative impacts of climate change and pollution on the world's oceans.
 
• The President's speech took place underwater at a depth of 121 meters, in a submersible off the coast of Seychelles.
 
• The initiative aimed to emphasize the importance of marine conservation and the necessity for global cooperation to safeguard oceanic ecosystems.
 
• The underwater speech was a call to action for the international community to take more robust measures to protect oceans and marine life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Seychelles** is an archipelago of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean, off East Africa.
 
• It is known for its stunning beaches, coral reefs, nature reserves, and rare wildlife such as giant Aldabra tortoises.
 
• Climate change and pollution pose significant threats to its marine and coastal ecosystems, which are vital to the country's economy and biodiversity.
 
• The country has been actively involved in international efforts to promote sustainable development and environmental conservation.
